planets.name: WASP-97 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-97 with a 2.07-day year, found in 2014.

text.card: WASP-97 b was found in 2014 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-97. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
